label: Where it stands
value: On the slope below Raja Gira Castle, Udegram (Odigram), Lower Swat
quote: found by chance on the slopes of the hill below the castle of Raja Gira

label: Founded
value: HE 440 (1048-49 CE), by the Ghaznavid general Amir Nustagin, per the inscription
quote: The inscription attests to the foundation of a mosque in HE 440 (1048–49 CE)

label: Excavated
quote: The excavation carried out in the area between 1985 and 1999

label: What to see
value: Hypostyle prayer hall, rectangular, 28 m by 21 m, with stone pillar bases
quote: is rectangular in plan, measuring 28m by 21m

label: Nearby tomb
value: Ghazi Baba tomb, a small mausoleum built over a saint's tomb
quote: a small and simple mausoleum was erected

label: Best time
value: Summer, when visitors come to Swat
quote: This historical mosque is a place for visitor attractions when people visit Swat in summer.
